title: Software Engineer - Java Fullstack
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Role Summary**


The Software Engineer \- Grade 26 contributes to the design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of software solutions that support business and customer outcomes. This role applies coding skills to defined capabilities with limited guidance, builds an understanding of system architecture and upstream/downstream dependencies, and supports quality, reliability, security, and maintainability in every deliverable.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, debug, test, deploy, and maintain assigned software capabilities, features, APIs, services, scripts, or application components
* Write clean, secure, reusable, and maintainable code that aligns with team standards, engineering practices, and quality expectations
* Apply an automation\-first mindset by improving repeatable development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support tasks
* Participate in Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demos, reviews, and retrospectives
* Collaborate with product owners, business partners, quality engineers, architects, and peer engineers to translate requirements into working solutions
* Develop an understanding of application architecture, cost/complexity tradeoffs, and dependencies across upstream and downstream systems
* Instrument delivered features using standard logging, monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic practices so issues can be detected and resolved early
* Support production readiness by contributing to CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, deployment validation, incident analysis, and post\-release improvements
* Troubleshoot defects, performance bottlenecks, data issues, and operational problems; recommend corrective actions with guidance from senior engineers
* Continuously learn modern engineering practices, cloud, DevOps, security, AI\-enabled development methods, and emerging tools relevant to the team's technology stack
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* Typically 2\+ years of relevant professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability
* Hands\-on experience with at least one modern programming language such as Java, Python, C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Angular or similar
* Experience developing or supporting web applications, APIs, backend services, batch jobs, cloud\-native services, or enterprise application components
* Working knowledge of software development fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, debugging, unit testing, and version control
* Awareness of CI/CD practices, automated testing, code quality tools, observability, secure coding, and production support expectations
* Demonstrated ability to analyze problems, learn unfamiliar systems, communicate clearly, and deliver assigned work with quality and accountability

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP
* Experience with monitoring or diagnostics tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or similar
* Exposure to microservices, REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, containers, Kubernetes/OpenShift, or platform engineering concepts
* Working knowledge of relational or NoSQL databases and basic data modeling principles
* Exposure to healthcare, claims, compliance, security, or regulated enterprise environments
* Proven interest in using AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve design, coding, testing, documentation, and delivery productivity

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Lead Full stack Developer
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


This role for an experienced full\-stack lead engineer to provide people engineering SME and support to our business partners in the Asset Management. The candidate should be hands on in advanced programing, visualization, analytical models and algorithms. The candidate should demonstrate strong technical/problem solving skills, manage multiple projects collaboratively and ensure adherence to enterprise standards. You’ll work with smart, talented people across our business to create innovative, next\-generation cloud\-based applications, and analytics/models. You’ll be involved, hands\-on, through the entire development cycle. And you’ll redefine the way our traders, portfolio managers and analysts support our clients.
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer Lead with strong expertise in Python, React, SQL, and AWS to build and support scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for application design, development, testing, deployment, and production support while collaborating closely with business and technology teams.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Planning \& Analysis**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and project goals.
* Perform impact analysis, solution design, and effort estimation.
* Participate in code reviews and provide technical guidance to development teams

 **Design \& Development**

* Design and develop web applications using Python, React, SQL, and AWS
* Build REST APIs, backend services, and responsive user interfaces.
* Create technical designs, engineering specifications, and low\-level design documents
* Ensure adherence to coding standards and SDLC processes

 **Testing \& Deployment**

* Develop and execute unit tests
* Support integration, UAT, and production deployments
* Troubleshoot issues and provide timely resolution during testing and post\-production

 **Documentation \& Support**

* Maintain technical, operational, and project documentation.
* Provide production support and application enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, and scalability

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in software development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with: Python (Fast API, Flask, or Django)React.jsSQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway)
* Experience with REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
* AWS certification preferred.
* Experience working in cloud\-native and microservices\-based environments

 **In\-Office Collaboration**


We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

title: Technical Lead- Engineering
description:
General Purpose Lead a team of 4–8 engineers with complete ownership and accountability for high\-quality, timely software delivery. Lead the design and development of applications based on Microservices architecture. Guide team members on modern technologies including Java, Spring, Spring Boot, Angular, Hibernate, Grails, Groovy, Kafka, R, Redis, Hazelcast, Bootstrap and jQuery. Leverage development and delivery tools including AWS, Git, Nginx, Jira, Confluence and Jenkins within Agile methodologies. Promote effective use of AI\-assisted software engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Amazon Q Developer and similar AI coding, code\-review, testing, documentation and developer productivity tools, while ensuring secure and responsible adoption. Collaborate with technical managers, architects and product owners to build an integrated, enterprise\-class software product suite for global pharmaceutical companies. Responsibilities Lead the team in understanding product requirements by collaborating with Product Owners; design application modules and features for performance, scalability, security and availability. Plan, prioritize and monitor team tasks for upcoming sprints and product releases. Conduct design reviews and code reviews, troubleshoot complex issues and provide hands\-on technical guidance. Own the quality and timely delivery of tasks assigned to the team. Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Project Managers, Test Managers, Database teams and Quality teams to deliver product features, releases and technical PoCs using Agile methodologies. Define, improve and enforce engineering best practices covering architecture, design, coding standards, code review, unit testing and documentation. Evaluate and drive practical adoption of AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve developer productivity, code quality, test automation, documentation and troubleshooting. Establish appropriate review and governance practices for AI\-generated code, including security, maintainability, licensing, data privacy and adherence to engineering standards. Perform annual appraisals and participate in semi\-annual formal feedback cycles for team members. Own hiring, mentoring, grooming and development of team members in both technology capabilities and career progression. Proactively identify and communicate improvement opportunities related to people, processes, technology, quality and delivery to management. Must Have Qualifications BE/B.Tech/MCA from a recognized institute with a good academic record. At least 6\+ years of full\-stack programming experience across Java\-based technologies and frameworks. Strong experience with Spring Framework and Hibernate\-based web application development. Strong experience designing and developing high\-performance, scalable, secure and highly available enterprise web applications end to end. Strong problem\-solving, debugging and troubleshooting skills. Hands\-on approach to resolving complex technical challenges faced by the team. Good working exposure to relational databases such as MySQL and Oracle. Practical experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent tools is highly desirable. Understanding of effective and responsible use of AI tools for coding, refactoring, test generation, code review, documentation and developer productivity. Self\-driven and motivated leader who can drive quality and timely delivery with complete ownership and accountability. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to take initiative, make sound technical decisions and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

Pay: ₹3,000,000\.00 \- ₹3,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Full Stack Developer
description:

* Set up and configure the React/Next.js project structure.
* Rebuild login page and implement secure routing.
* Recreate chat UI to match FinIQ design standards.
* Build chatbot page with input field, chat history, and API integration.
* Develop admin dashboard with role\-based access control.
* Ensure responsive, accessible, and high\-performance UI.

**Backend/API Integration:**

* Integrate with existing **FastAPI** endpoints.
* Collaborate with backend teams to ensure smooth data flow.
* Apply working knowledge of **Node.js, Flask, and FastAPI** to troubleshoot and enhance API interactions.

* Working knowledge of **Node.js, Flask, and FastAPI**.
* Experience with **Git**, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows.

title: Frontend / Full Stack Developer
description:
**Frontend / Full Stack Developer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our services include cosmetic safety, regulatory compliance, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship and brand protection across international markets.

We are expanding our technology capabilities and are looking for a **Frontend / Full Stack Developer** to help create modern, responsive and scalable digital products and applications for GCRS.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing user\-facing applications while also having the ability to work across the backend where required.

You will work closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, product stakeholders and business teams to turn concepts and requirements into functional digital products.

The role will involve building new features, improving existing applications, integrating APIs, troubleshooting technical issues and ensuring that our products provide a fast, intuitive and reliable user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop responsive and user\-friendly web applications
* Build reusable frontend components
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional interfaces
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs
* Develop and maintain application features
* Work with backend developers on full\-stack functionality
* Optimize applications for speed and performance
* Ensure compatibility across modern browsers and devices
* Identify and resolve frontend and application issues
* Write clean and maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
* Implement appropriate testing practices
* Work with designers to ensure accurate implementation of designs
* Collaboration with product and business stakeholders
* Maintain technical documentation where required
* Support deployment and maintenance of applications
* Improve accessibility and usability
* Contribute to frontend development standards
* Identify opportunities for automation and technical improvement

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a developer who combines strong front\-end skills with a broader understanding of full\-stack application development.

You should have a strong eye for detail and care about both technical quality and the user experience.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in frontend or full\-stack development
* Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Experience with React, Next.js, Vue or a similar modern framework
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs
* Understanding of responsive web design
* Knowledge of Git and version Control
* Understanding of browser compatibility and web performance
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of basic backend concepts
* Ability to work with databases and APIs
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to understand UI/UX designs and implement them accurately
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non\-technical teams

**Desirable Experience**

* TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL and other relational or modern database technologies.
* Hands\-on knowledge of cloud deployment, authentication and authorization systems.
* A background in developing dashboards and data\-intensive applications.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks and AI\-enabled application development

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Delivered high\-quality frontend features
* Improved existing interfaces and application performance
* Worked effectively with the UI/UX and backend teams
* Contributed to scalable frontend architecture
* Reduced recurring technical issues
* Improved the consistency and usability of our digital products
* Delivered projects within agreed timelines
* Contributed to a stronger development workflow

**Why Join Us?**

You will join a growing international organisation where technology is becoming an increasingly important part of our services and operations. You will have the opportunity to work on new products rather than simply maintaining legacy systems, with scope to grow into a senior developer, full\-stack or technical leadership role.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person
